The '''Battle of Hoth''' that occurred during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Convenient" /> was between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]] pilots defended Rebel ground troops from several [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT walkers]].<ref name="ST2" />

A [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]] passenger ship piloted by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] accidentally ended up in the middle of the battle after fleeing into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to escape an Imperial [[raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. One Rebel pilot warned to the StarSpeeder to leave the combat area, but the speeder was briefly disabled by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire from a walker and slid down a snowy mountainside before launching back into space.<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was one of many scenes featured in [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney Parks']] ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' attraction. It was one of various options that guests randomly encountered on the ride. Originally Disney [[Walt Disney Imagineering|Imagineers]] planned to not include snowspeeders and AT-ATs in the [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] sequence, for fear of conflicting with the battle from {{Film|V}}, set years later. Learning of the plan, [[George Lucas]] insisted the designers include those elements since fans would expect them when visiting Hoth. Lucas suggested another battle between the two factions could have happened earlier, with the Empire not expecting the Rebels to return to the same place.<ref name="Taking a trip">{{WebCite|url=http://travel.usatoday.com/alliance/destinations/mouseplanet/post/2012/05/Taking-a-Trip-on-Star-Tours/685697/1|text=Taking a Trip on Star Tours|author=Korkis, Jim|date=2012-05-02|archivedate=20120627091717}}</ref><ref name="SWI 127">{{InsiderCite|127|The Incredible Journey}}</ref>
